market.title: Kevin Durant's Next Team
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever team Kevin Durant is officially under contract with, or takes the floor for, during the 2026-27 NBA season - if he's still with Houston or has retired by the close date, that resolves the 'Houston Rockets' side to Yes instead.
Kalshi's own wording: "If Kevin Durant's next team is Stays with Houston or Retires before Oct 21, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."
No genuinely matching Polymarket market exists for this one, so this page is Kalshi-only.

text: At 37 years of age, Kevin Durant is far from slowing down, bagging 26 points, 5.5 rebounds, and 4.8 assists per game this season.
Despite this, the Rockets have reportedly told rivals that a deal for Durant is not completely out of the question.
Sports media personality Nick Pedone added fuel to the transfer-speculation fire when he said he could see a deal between the Cavs and Houston happening.
Pedone called Durant 'probably the last big fish remaining this offseason' for a Cavaliers team already built around Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, and Evan Mobley.
Remaining at Houston is still the most likely scenario, but stranger things have happened, and the price for the Cavs is increasing as the rumor mill turns.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
